stories.title: Carburants : Lecornu a demandé à ses ministres de «prolonger» jusqu’au 31 décembre les aides ciblées

en.title: Fuel: Lecornu asked his ministers to 'extend' targeted aid until 31 December
en.summary: France's government is extending targeted fuel subsidies through the end of the year following a presidential directive for mobilized action on fuel supply and price control.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : Sébastien Lecornu prolonge les aides ciblées jusqu’au 31 décembre

en.title: Fuel prices: Sébastien Lecornu extends targeted aid until 31 December
en.summary: The French government is extending targeted fuel support measures through December 31st in response to presidential demands for coordinated government action on fuel supplies and pricing.

stories.title: Le socialiste Philippe Brun exclu de la primaire pour des accusations de «violences» sur une ex-collaboratrice

en.title: Socialist Philippe Brun excluded from primary over accusations of 'violence' against a former aide
en.summary: A Socialist deputy from Eure was excluded from an internal party primary after the Socialist Party's national board voted to suspend him pending accusations of violence against a former collaborator.

stories.title: Exclu de la primaire, Philippe Brun accuse le Parti socialiste de vouloir le "tuer politiquement" et dénonce des "accusations calomnieuses" de violences

en.title: Excluded from primary, Philippe Brun accuses Socialist Party of wanting to 'kill him politically' and denounces 'slanderous' violence accusations
en.summary: An excluded primary candidate denied violence allegations against a former colleague, stating the accusations damage his reputation and announcing his intention to pursue legal action.

stories.title: Le procès de Rachida Dati et de Carlos Ghosn pour corruption est maintenu, l'ex-PDG jugé en son absence

en.title: The trial of Rachida Dati and Carlos Ghosn for corruption is upheld, the former CEO judged in absentia
en.summary: A Paris court rejected Carlos Ghosn's request to postpone his trial and proceeded to judge him in his absence. Ghosn and Rachida Dati face corruption and influence peddling charges.

stories.title: "Il est temps pour elle de s'expliquer" : le procès de Rachida Dati pour corruption maintenu, malgré l'absence de Carlos Ghosn

en.title: "It is time for her to explain herself": Rachida Dati's corruption trial upheld, despite Carlos Ghosn's absence
en.summary: A Paris court examined and rejected the postponement request made by the former Renault CEO, who is sheltering in Lebanon. The court decided to proceed with Ghosn's trial in absentia.

stories.title: Au procès de Rachida Dati, l’ombre de Carlos Ghosn en fuite au Liban : «La réalité, c’est qu’il ne veut pas participer à cette audience»

en.title: At Rachida Dati's trial, the shadow of Carlos Ghosn fleeing to Lebanon: "The reality is that he does not want to participate in this hearing"
en.summary: The Paris correctional court began proceedings against the former Culture Minister for passive corruption and abuse of power. The ex-Renault CEO, who did not appoint legal representation, was examined as part of the trial.

stories.title: Philippe Brun, suspendu du PS et écarté de la primaire à gauche, se dit victime d’une dénonciation calomnieuse et annonce déposer plainte

en.title: Philippe Brun, suspended from the PS and excluded from the left-wing primary, says he is a victim of false accusation and announces he will file a complaint
en.summary: A French deputy claims he was wrongfully suspended from his party and removed from the primary race. He alleges a dispute with a former collaborator was manipulated to damage his political career.

stories.title: Ouverture du procès de Rachida Dati, interdiction des réseaux aux moins de 13 ans dans l’UE, 21 morts à Gaza… L’actu de ce mercredi 16 septembre

en.title: Trial opening for Rachida Dati, ban on social networks for under-13s in the EU, 21 dead in Gaza… Wednesday September 16 news
en.summary: Libération reports on major news events of the day, including the opening of Rachida Dati's trial, EU social media restrictions for minors, and casualties in Gaza.

stories.title: France : retour sur les raisons du procès de Rachida Dati et Renault-Nissan

en.title: France: Background on Rachida Dati's trial and Renault-Nissan
en.summary: Rachida Dati faces trial starting Wednesday for corruption and influence trafficking, accused of receiving 900,000 euros from former Renault-Nissan CEO Carlos Ghosn while serving as MEP; Ghosn is also being prosecuted.

stories.title: Présidentielle en France : Philippe Brun suspendu pour par le Parti socialiste avant la primaire

en.title: French presidential race: Philippe Brun suspended by Socialist Party before primary
en.summary: The Socialist Party suspended deputy Philippe Brun and excluded him from the social-democrat primary over violence accusations. Brun stated he is unaware of the specific charges against him.

stories.title: Six questions sur le procès pour corruption de Rachida Dati et Carlos Ghosn, ex-PDG de Renault

en.title: Six questions about the corruption trial of Rachida Dati and Carlos Ghosn, former Renault CEO
en.summary: The former French minister received 900,000 euros in consulting fees from Renault-Nissan and appears before Paris criminal court starting Wednesday facing corruption and influence trafficking charges.

stories.title: La Fed relève ses taux et ouvre une nouvelle séquence monétaire

en.title: The Fed raises rates and opens a new monetary sequence
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased rates by 25 basis points, marking a return to monetary tightening as inflation and oil prices complicate conditions under new leadership.

stories.title: Avec son algorithme, OùSoigner veut accélérer l’installation des médecins dans les déserts médicaux

en.title: With its algorithm, OùSoigner wants to accelerate doctor placements in medical deserts
en.summary: OùSoigner is a collaborative platform using an algorithm to match physicians seeking to establish practices with underserved communities lacking medical professionals.

stories.title: Avec 61 milliards d’euros de dividendes, la France prend la tête en Europe

en.title: With 61 billion euros in dividends, France takes the lead in Europe
en.summary: Major French listed companies distributed 61 billion euros in dividends to shareholders, placing France first in Europe and second globally after the United States.

stories.title: OPINION. « Immigration : pourquoi la France ne peut plus raisonner seule », par Mickaël Haïk, avocat aux barreaux de Paris et du Québec

en.title: OPINION. "Immigration: why France can no longer reason alone", by Mickaël Haïk, lawyer at the Paris and Quebec bars
en.summary: A migration law specialist argues that European migration policies, which have continental consequences, remain primarily decided at the national level rather than collectively.

stories.title: « Doubler les performances de ses prédécesseurs » : focus sur les Sentinel 3 avec Yvan Baillion

en.title: "Doubling the performance of its predecessors": focus on Sentinel 3 with Yvan Baillion
en.summary: The Sentinel 3C satellite successfully launched on September 15 aboard Vega-C and joined the European Copernicus program, with plans already underway for successor missions.
